units.en: Who goes to the market?
Is Rami a cat?
Where does Rami go?
Who is Maher?
What does Maher do?
Is Rami fast?
Why is he fast?
Why is Maher slow?
What did Mazen say?
Who saw Hani on the way?
What are the two of them doing?
Do they drink coffee?
Does Rami keep walking after the tea?
Where did Rami sleep?
Does Maher sleep too?
Who sees Maher at the end?
units.say: Who... sees Maher, at the end?

units.en: What does Kamel say?
Who arrived first?
Why did Maher arrive before Rami?
Excellent! You understood the whole story.
Words from the story, and their opposites.
units.say: Words from the story... and their opposites.

units.en: Fast, and slow.
Rami is fast, like a car. And Maher is slow, like… a turtle!
We say: walk fast, or: walk slowly. Please, speak slowly!
Before, and after.
Before the tea, after the tea.
We say them every day: before the lesson, after the lesson. Before sleep, after sleep.
With, and without.
Coffee with milk, and tea without sugar.
I go with my friend. I go without my friend.
Sleeps, and wakes up.
At night I sleep, and in the morning I wake up.
Rami slept under the tree… and when did he wake up? After Maher arrived!
Here, and there.
"Here" is for near, and "there" for far. Where is the market? There!
Where are you? I'm here!

outro.en: Like this video if it helped, and subscribe: next, the story in the past!

units.en: Now we tell the story in the past. The story was yesterday.
Pay attention: the verb changes a little. Goes, went. Drinks, drank. Sleeps, slept.
Rami the horse went to the market.
And Maher the turtle went to the market too.
units.say: And Maher, the turtle, went to the market too.

units.en: Rami was fast because he is a horse; he walked fast.
And Maher was slow because he is a turtle. He walked slowly.
Mazen the fox said: the horse will arrive before the turtle!
On the way, Rami saw his friend Hani the sheep.
Rami drank tea with the sheep.
After the tea, Rami slept under the tree.
units.say: After the tea... Rami slept under the tree.

units.en: But Maher didn't sleep, and kept going slowly.
Kamel the bird saw Maher and said: excellent!
And Maher arrived at the market before Rami!

outro.en: Like this video if it helped, and subscribe: next, the story in the future!

units.en: And now, the story in the future: tomorrow!
We put "sa" before the verb: goes, will go. Drinks, will drink. Easy!
units.say: We put the sound "sa" in front of the verb. Goes... it will go. Drinks... it will drink. Easy!

units.en: Tomorrow, Rami the horse will go to the market.
And Maher the turtle will go to the market too.
Rami will see his friend Hani the sheep.
Rami will drink tea with the sheep.
After the tea, Rami will sleep under the tree.
But Maher won't sleep; he will keep going slowly.
units.say: But Maher... won't sleep. He will keep going slowly.

units.en: Kamel the bird will see Maher and will say: excellent!
units.say: Kamel... the bird, will see Maher, and will say: excellent!

units.en: And Maher will arrive at the market before Rami!
